test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Each team were wearing a different coloured dress.
solution: The erroneous part is **'Each team were'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here,** 'Each team was' **should be used instead of** 'Each team were'.** • We know that after 'each, every, everyone, someone, nobody, one' a singular verb, singular noun, singular adjective, and a singular pronoun is used. • *Example: Each student has come.* • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Each team was wearing a different coloured dress.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां 'Each team were' की जगह 'Each team was' का इस्तेमाल करना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि 'every, each, everyone, someone, nobody, one' के बाद singular verb, singular noun, singular adjective और singular pronoun का प्रयोग किया जाता है। • *Example: Each student has come.* • अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है। 3e:Tdf4, The correct answer is** 'have not'.**
